from autosdv_gui_pkg.main import configure_default_dds_profile,MainWindow
configure_default_dds_profile()
import rclpy,time,json,subprocess
from diagnostic_msgs.msg import DiagnosticArray
from sensor_msgs.msg import Image
from interfaces_pkg.msg import SafetyStatus
from rclpy.qos import qos_profile_sensor_data
rclpy.init();n=rclpy.create_node('bridge_announcement_validation');latest={};frames={i:0 for i in range(1,6)}
n.create_subscription(DiagnosticArray,'/ivn/diagnostics/status',lambda m:latest.update(diag=m),10)
n.create_subscription(SafetyStatus,'/safety/status',lambda m:latest.update(safety=m),10)
def spin(seconds):
 end=time.monotonic()+seconds
 while time.monotonic()<end:rclpy.spin_once(n,timeout_sec=.1)
